name: Madelyne Pryor

abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Force Field: Gelen hasara karşı geçici bir koruma kalkanı oluşturur.
abilityDetails.Hinder: Yeni oluşturulan tüm buff'ların gücünü belirli bir yüzde azaltır.
abilityDetails.Fear: Unblockable yetenek doğruluğunu sabit %100 azaltır ve Mükemmel Blok Şansını kaldırır.
abilityDetails.Inexorable: Temel saldırılarla geri itilemez ve temel saldırılardan kazanılan güç artar.
abilityDetails.Power Steal: Hedefin gücünü azaltıp aynı miktarı kendine kazandırır.
abilityDetails.Uncanny: Özel saldırıların harcadığı gücü belirtilen miktarda azaltır ve düşük güç seviyesinde etkinleştirilmesine izin verir.
abilityDetails.Pre-Fight: Dövüş başlamadan önce Pre-Fight ekranından değiştirilebilen yetenek.
abilityDetails.Infuriate: Rakip daha saldırgan hale gelir ve saldırı yetenek doğruluğu azalır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): E2'si 15sn'lik bir alan açar, o alanda bonus aktive edersen pasif degeneration alırsın — E2'ye ulaşmasına izin verme veya bonus immün şampiyon kullan. Dexterity bonusu tetiklemeyen şampiyonlar (Shuri, Silk, Blue Marvel) da iyi seçenek.
signatureAbility:
The Goblin Queen
Madelyne starts each Quest with a Goblin Horde that persists until the end of the Quest. When she defeats a Defender, she summons another. Max stacks: [1 - 4] (rounded down).
For each Horde, Madelyne starts each fight with a [5 - 20]% Uncanny Passive. These last until she activates a Special Attack.
In the Pre-Fight Menu, Madelyne can expend Hordes to carry out various tasks:
Crib Swap: The first Buff the Opponent gains is immediately Nullified. After 15 seconds, they gain a +[306.82] Cruelty Buff for 30 seconds.
Goblin Instigators: While the pit is active, the Opponent is inflicted with a 30% Infuriate Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Scythe of Sorrows - Always Active
content: When the Scythe Interrupts an Opponent's Heavy Charge, or Punishes their Heavy, Combo-Ending, or Special Attack, it places a +100 Misery Buff for 6 seconds.
Time slows briefly when a Hindered Defender charges a Heavy Attack or finishes a Combo-Ending Attack.
When a Buff with reduced potency activates on the Opponent, inflict a Degeneration Passive dealing up to [293,310] Direct Damage, scaling with the Buff's missing potency, over 9 seconds.
Cosmic Opponents suffer -100% Inexorable Ability Accuracy.

abilitySections.title: Force Field - Max Integrity: 100% of Max Health
content: Madelyne starts each fight with a Force Field with integrity equal to 20% of her Max Health.
While charging her Heavy Attack, Madelyne converts Power into integrity, converting faster the longer she charges.
When Madelyne would take damage from being struck by or Blocking hits, the Force Field's integrity takes 50% or 100% (respectively) of the damage instead.
When preventing damage, the Force Field expends less integrity the higher the Opponent's Block Penetration.
As an Attacker, while her Force Field has integrity, Madelyne is Immune to Bleed and Rupture. When Immune to one or more of either, the Force Field gains +5% of starting integrity.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - Negative Energy Beam
content: Beam hits restore +5% of starting integrity to Madelyne's Force Field, increased by an additional +2% for each Buff on the Opponent, up to 15. Power Gain Buffs count as 3 Buffs.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - Pit to Otherplace
content: At the end of this attack, Madelyne summons a pit of grasping, clawing arms for 15 seconds, if not already active.
When the Opponent enters the pit, inflict an 80% Hinder Debuff and a Fear Passive, both for 3 seconds. While in the pit, Misery, Hinder, and Fear effects are paused.

While Madelyne is in the pit, her Parry Stun expires 100% faster but is paused while charging Heavy Attacks, and she gains a 100% Inexorable Passive. During Cosmic Special Attacks, this becomes a Special Inexorable.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - From Limbo With Love
content: Once used, this attack cannot be used again for 60 seconds.
Power Steal all Bars of Power that are completely full. Madelyne gains 50% of the Power Stolen.
After 10 seconds, for each Bar stolen this way, the Opponent gains a Power Gain Buff, granting 50% of a Bar of Power over 15 seconds.
